title: Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content: Aerogel Research Institute. The Technical Institute of Physics and Chemistry, Chinese Academy of Sciences, is a multidisciplinary research institute covering chemistry, materials, and applied physical technologies. Its official updates include biomass aerogel research, making it relevant for aerogel chemistry, materials development, and technical evaluation.
